title: ENV-0 / HOUSE HUMAN HARNESS
law: Keep one physical HOUSE locus stable while the human changes coupling, tool, action and evidence state. Harness state may coordinate action; it never manufactures world evidence or transfers native authority.

center.identity_rule: The HOUSE address remains stable across layer and execution-state changes unless an explicit REFRAME binds another locus.

interface.phase_rail: UNBOUND → ORIENTED → EQUIPPED → ENGAGED → ACTED → WITNESSED → RETURNED
interface.crew_satellite: Shows only the current crew frame, ≤3 permitted non-effectful moves, and any bounded worker offer.
interface.progressive_rule: Show the active layer, current phase, current gate and next ≤3 moves. Deep state stays machine-readable rather than becoming a mega-panel.

layers.label: YOU / BODY
layers.role: Embodied capability and fresh human/world observation: reach, posture, comfort, effort, attention, carried load and direct sensation when relevant.
layers.authority: Human evidence. HOUSE selection never implies presence, capability or condition.

layers.label: LOADOUT / HARNESS
layers.role: The bounded coupling set carried into the task: tools, marks, surfaces, cassettes, fixtures, instructions, context and feedback channels.
layers.authority: Capability description only. Listing a tool does not grant permission to use it.

layers.label: TOUCH / OBJECT
layers.role: The immediate thing, fixture, tool, surface or mechanism being inspected, changed or verified.
layers.authority: Native lifecycle/physical truth remains with the object owner and world evidence.

layers.label: HERE / ROOM
layers.role: Exact HOUSE address, clearances, access path and local environmental constraints around the operation.
layers.authority: HOUSE spatial address plus authored measurements/evidence; selection is not occupancy.

layers.label: HOME / HOUSE
layers.role: Whole-dwelling topology, permanence, resources, maintenance and cross-room consequence.
layers.authority: HOUSE coordinates projections; ownership does not waive structural, utility, fire, code or safety proof.

layers.label: RUNTIME / NETWORK
layers.role: Sensors, digital services, agents and private runtime that can observe or act under explicit host permissions.
layers.authority: Home Assistant / HOUSEBUS retains private device truth, permissions and actuation. External workers remain OFFER_ONLY unless a separate native host grants tools.

phases.meaning: No exact HOUSE locus is bound.
Exact locus, task intent and known constraints are visible enough to reason about the work.
Relevant harness/loadout and capabilities are selected or proposed.
Exact object/contact/operation and discriminating verification are identified.
A human or separately authorized native host caused a bounded effect. Public HOUSE itself never supplies effect authority.
Fresh after-state or host result has been observed and attached without inference inflation.
Decision, residue, evidence and continuation point have been emitted back to HOUSE/FIELD.

requires: required choice/acknowledgement for the effect class
fresh observed consequence or host-native result

human_gates.NONE: Crew may inspect, research, check, draft, navigate or propose without interrupting the human. No effect authority follows.
human_gates.PING: One lightweight human acknowledgement or readiness signal materially selects continuation; keep it one-bit where possible.
human_gates.CHOOSE: Preference, framing, adoption, irreversible direction or trade-off belongs to the human.
human_gates.WORLD_RETURN: Fresh physical or subjective evidence must come from the world/human/native host. Workers specify the evidence needed but must not synthesize it.

effect_authority.HUMAN_PHYSICAL: human directly performs a physical operation
effect_authority.HOST_NATIVE: a separately authorized application/tool performs its native effect
effect_authority.HA_HOUSEBUS_PRIVATE: private Home Assistant/HOUSEBUS actuation under its own permissions

safety_and_permanence.reversible_default: Prefer a reversible bounded trial while uncertainty is high, even when the dwelling is owned.
safety_and_permanence.permanent_work: Permanent/structural/utility work requires explicit human CHOOSE plus relevant fresh WORLD_RETURN and any external code/safety/engineering evidence the operation demands.
safety_and_permanence.no_certification: HOUSE/HARNESS does not certify structural, electrical, plumbing, fire, load, medical or legal fitness.

future_adapters.A2A: Map remote worker identity/task artifacts to bounded handoffs/returns; never inherit HOUSE effect authority.
future_adapters.AG_UI: Transport state deltas and human interrupts; HOUSE retains state/authority ownership.
future_adapters.A2UI: Remote workers may describe interface intent as data; trusted HOUSE components render it.

derivation.rule: This mapping is interface state only. In particular ACTED does not prove the physical change occurred unless fresh world/native evidence exists.
